note: Length is code points. The first quote is 11 code points but 13 UTF-16 units (each rocket is a surrogate pair) and more UTF-8 bytes, so String.length or byte length would wrongly pass it. The second is exactly 12 code points. 'café menu i' is 11 code points and 12 UTF-8 bytes; 'café menu is' is 12 code points.
